correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives \(\dot{\mathcal E}=-a(x-v_1)(x-v_2)y^2-\alpha\beta u^2+A y\sin\theta\). Invariance of \(u^2/2\) gives \(\langle uy\rangle=\beta\langle u^2\rangle\); invariance of polynomial primitives gives the restoring-force mean law; support invariance proves strict controller dissipation when \(A\omega\ne0\). The bundled symbolic checker independently simplifies the algebraic identities to zero.

value.rationale: The source motivates the controller as a way to regularize a chaotic cardiac model, but its evidence is local and numerical. The exact recurrent-state laws provide a global nonlinear diagnostic: on every compact recurrent regime the memory channel extracts energy on average, strictly so for the forced setup, and the external forcing, nonlinear damping/excitation, and controller loss satisfy a closed balance. This can detect sign or implementation mistakes and constrains any claimed stabilized or chaotic recurrent response without requiring long-time Lyapunov calculations.
